<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>GDP Growth:</strong> India’s Q1 FY27 GDP expanded by 7.8%, surpassing the 7.1% market estimate, leading brokerages to raise growth forecasts while signaling potential RBI rate hikes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> Domestic indices opened lower, with the Nifty trading near 24,050, as gains were offset by selling pressure in the pharma, realty, and banking sectors.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude Oil and Geopolitics:</strong> Brent crude prices crossing $91 per barrel, combined with heightened US-Iran tensions, have dampened investor sentiment and triggered a cautious start for Indian equities.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Debt Market Outlook:</strong> RBI liquidity management strategies and global interest rate trajectories are expected to be the primary drivers for the Indian debt market throughout September.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxOemZ3aUpBaWluMGxSV1BfX005ZUh1QXlRZUppeHJSZGJVQzQzeFpJWGxWbHNyY1JJeGxkNWlzYU5nWVc5NGVFbi1sQjRIR0dYTkZjbUZnd29kckVzQTQ1bmNkdTFYZWRyNXJpM1NkRE5mOVhESG0yMmFXSlNUeGYwM1RyMmRQUlVmdWJVdWp1N2VkSndKYkhEaU1KR21jVkV1OVNRMGF6aDBDS0JwS1VsTkViU3ppY3dHRjlRYzNTSi0yWmF0TThV?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
